headline: The desktop interface area covers 12 tickets; the code backs up 8 of them, including theming, settings, the collapsible sidebar, notifications, charts and permission prompts, while 4 could not be confirmed from the code that was examined.
what_is_there: Confirmed in the code: dark and light themes with accent colours, a settings screen reached from the top bar that re-applies theme/language/provider, a collapsible navigation sidebar with sub-tabs, in-app pop-up notifications, an on/off/auto model routing toggle, a smooth line chart used on the metrics dashboard, a file editing dialog, and an end-to-end permission request and confirmation flow.
what_is_unclear: The first-run welcome dialog (nickname/email setup) and the workspace member management dialog could not be confirmed because no interface code for them appeared in the subset that was read, and two broad tickets — the general 'Update UI/UX' item and the effort to improve the AI flow experience — contain no specific claim to check against code. For a few confirmed items, only the surrounding wiring was visible rather than the dialog itself, so sub-details like model selection and attachment limits in settings remain unconfirmed.
suggested_action: Ask the team to point to where the welcome dialog and workspace member management screens live, and to restate the two open UI/UX improvement tickets as specific, checkable outcomes. Separately, confirm whether the file editing dialog ticket should be closed, since the feature already appears built despite being marked To Do.
